bias.en: Pullback · steadied above $501, under the falling short averages
bias.zh: 回调 · 企稳 $501 上方，受制于下行的短期均线

read.en: Microsoft rose 0.4% on Nov 18 to $508.29, trading $501.08–510.44. It is below the 5-day ($515.9), 10-day ($524.5) and 30-day ($528.8), all falling, and above the 100-day ($484.5) and 200-day ($442.8), both rising. MACD has been below its signal since Nov 10, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 17 ($557.90), and RSI is 42.9.
read.zh: 微软 11月18日上涨 0.4%，收于 $508.29，盘中区间 $501.08–510.44。股价位于 5 日（$515.9）、10 日（$524.5）和 30 日均线（$528.8）下方，三者均在下行；位于 100 日（$484.5）和 200 日均线（$442.8）上方，两者均在上行。MACD 自 11月10日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图放大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月17日起看空（$557.90），RSI 为 42.9。

read.en: The $501.08 low dipped under the Nov 2 low ($504.96) intraday, but the close held above it. Resistance is $513.8–515.9 (Nov 13 low, Nov 17 high, 5-day), then $518–521.1 (Nov 16 and 11 closes) and $524.5–528.8 (10 and 30-day). Support is $501–505, then $496.5 (Nov 17 low) and $484.5–486 (100-day, Sep 10 low). A close above $515.9 would target $521–524.5; below $501, $496.5.
